content_of_post_to_answer: Why do some people never seem to get bored?
answer: People who rarely get bored often aren't avoiding boredom; they have learned how to interact with it. Boredom usually appears when we expect the outside world to keep supplying stimulation. Curious people turn empty moments into observation, imagination, questions, or experiments. The difference is not that they have more things to do, but that they have a richer relationship with their own attention. Boredom is often less a lack of entertainment and more a lack of engagement.
